Entry Requirements
 Regular Exchange: minimum Cumulative GPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale; must be a currently enrolled student.  Must have completed at least two
semesters at the home institution prior to the exchange period.
Course Load / Language Min. 12 – Max. 19 credits per semester  |  Instruction in English
